fieldNotes.location: Roster coordinates (26.163308, -98.003269) had a 3912 m geocode shift flag but actually land correctly on the campus. Web search confirmed H-E-B Weslaco Retail Distribution Support Center, 1100 Panther Dr, Weslaco TX 78596 — the RGV distribution + transportation/dispatch hub at ~26.1638, -98.0014.
fieldNotes.truckGate: Campus is enclosed by a chain-link perimeter fence (confirmed in Street View, 2026-04). Main truck entrance off Panther Dr (north) with an H-E-B sign and a defined driveway with bollards. truckGate true.
fieldNotes.guardShack: No staffed guard booth clearly resolved at the entrance; a small structure sits near the gate but could not be confirmed as a booth. Classified remoteGs true (kiosk / app check-in implied). Medium confidence — entrance area also has active construction.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Long dock-door banks on the warehouse south and west faces with trailers backed in; estimated ~70, into the 50+ band.
fieldNotes.dropArea: Multiple trailer drop yards with parked-trailer arrays on the NW and SW of the warehouse; over 50.
fieldNotes.postGateStaging: Large paved truck yard inside the gate before the docks.
fieldNotes.multipleFacilities: Campus includes the RSC distribution warehouse plus a separate transportation / dispatch / facility-maintenance building (Yelp lists 'HEB Weslaco Dispatch' and 'HEB Weslaco Facility Maint' at the same address).
fieldNotes.drivewayLong: Deep paved truck yard between the gate and the dock doors; ample stacking room.
fieldNotes.fastLaneOpportunity: Wide gate apron and truck yard with unused paved width — room for a dedicated express lane.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Inside the city of Weslaco — residential to the south, a school to the NE, retail nearby, expressway frontage. Classified Urban.
fieldNotes.railServed: A rail line runs E-W along the south of the campus but no spur enters the property — separated by a land strip and the trailer yard.
fieldNotes.siteAreaAcres: Estimate from perimeter box covering the fenced campus.
